brief:
Israeli authorities are preparing a new scheme to reorganize road networks in central Ramallah and Al-Bireh that would open a main route for settler movement while constraining Palestinian mobility, Hebrew daily Haaretz reported. The plan coincides with new military measures expected to further limit Palestinian movement in the area.

The configuration would reshape traffic patterns across the West Bank governorate, redirecting flow to facilitate settler access while narrowing Palestinian passage through key routes.
